channel.title: Microsoft for Education Daily
channel.description: The latest Microsoft updates for schools, universities and TAFEs in three minutes, every morning, with who each update is for, its status and its sources. An independent recap, not an official Microsoft channel.

item.title: EP.029 · ON YOUR TERMS.
item.description: School IT can now lock Copilot Chat to Study and Learn, university leaders get a new AI guide, and Fabric adds a pay-as-you-go F0 capacity in preview.

item.title: EP.028 · IN SAFE HANDS.
item.description: OneDrive gives every file and folder one link that follows your sharing settings, GitHub and Power Pages get handy previews, and Edge tests a Lockdown Mode.

item.title: EP.027 · ON THE SAME PAGE.
item.description: Teams will let you pop out a sign language interpreter, Edge 158 puts workspaces in one window, Foundry previews Programmed Training, and a Cornell-LSU team wins a $200,000 quantum prize.

item.title: EP.026 · USE WHAT YOU HAVE.
item.description: Wales' Hwb gets a new look with Microsoft 365 still free at home, GitHub Desktop handles more than one account, and new Teams releases need iOS or iPadOS 18 from mid-December.

item.title: EP.025 · PLAN AHEAD.
item.description: Microsoft To Do will retire in June 2027 as school accounts move to Planner, Study and Learn assignments are rolling out, and Teams' new meeting controls and Windows' room captions are on their way.

item.title: EP.024 · START BUILDING.
item.description: Hour of AI is out with a free Microsoft Elevate course for teachers, Minecraft Education adds a free Field Agent lesson, and Baseline security mode 2026 rolls out.

item.title: EP.023 · YOUR CLASS, YOUR RULES.
item.description: Teachers can now assign Copilot's Study and Learn with their own AI rules, Microsoft Classroom gets roadmap dates, and Ignite brings admin rights per task to Windows.

item.title: EP.022 · PRESS START.
item.description: Durham switches on Microsoft 365 Copilot for every student (reported), Windows gets a remote lock for lost laptops in preview, and Windows Server 2016's last security update lands in January.

item.title: EP.021 · SAVE THE DATE.
item.description: Dates to note: Teams two-presenter sharing moves to January, Minecraft publishes a Parents' Guide, and Microsoft Ignite runs 17-20 November.

item.title: EP.020 · BACK TO CLASS.
item.description: Microsoft 365 is back after the outage, fake outage notices are doing the rounds, and teachers get Minecraft and AI workshop news from Spain and Italy.

item.title: EP.019 · SMALL WINS.
item.description: Windows' Release Preview brings small wins for classrooms, Microsoft apologised for the outage that hit schools, and Xbox's 25th brings a free Minecraft skin.

item.title: EP.018 · LEVEL UP.
item.description: Students will soon rehearse presentations with Speaker Coach, Learning Zone is getting Minecraft lessons, and Microsoft Classroom is coming to current A1 plans too.

item.title: EP.017 · MAKE IT YOURS.
item.description: Microsoft Classroom opens preview sign-ups for early 2027, Visual Studio lets coders bring their own AI model, and November's updates patch an exploited Outlook flaw.

item.title: EP.016 · STAY CURRENT.
item.description: Ohio State and Microsoft plan five years of AI learning, certifications and cloud work, .NET 11 ships for student coders, and Git 2.56.1 fixes six security flaws.

item.title: EP.015 · LOOK BEFORE YOU LEAP.
item.description: Manchester pilots Microsoft 365 Copilot before every student gets it, Word flags fake headings for Insiders, and Power Pages admins get per-site sign-in controls in preview.

item.title: EP.014 · ONE STEP AT A TIME.
item.description: The week's best for education: a study finds revealing slides step by step helps students find the point, passkey-first sign-in rolls out in Entra, and Kimi K3.1 Pro arrives in Foundry.

item.title: EP.013 · EVERYONE IN.
item.description: The week's best for education: Narrator reads math on Braille displays for Insiders, Live captions follows your mic, and App Blocks rolls out in Copilot Chat.

item.title: EP.012 · PLAN AHEAD.
item.description: Plan ahead: Microsoft 365 Education gets a new lineup from A0 to A7 and Microsoft Classroom, with most changes at renewals from January 2028.

item.title: EP.011 · PAUSE AND QUESTION.
item.description: Pause and question: 2,000 Filipino teachers are set to earn AI literacy credentials, Behind the Chat helps teens think twice, and Teams Rooms is due to show two screens at once.

item.title: EP.010 · LEARN BY DOING.
item.description: Learn by doing: a Wisconsin college trains data centre technicians with Microsoft, VS Code lets agents check each other's work, and Teams' Facilitator is due to turn meetings into slides.

item.title: EP.009 · ROOM TO LEARN.
item.description: Room to learn: Windows gets snappier on 8 GB PCs, an Ontario board opens Copilot's Study and Learn to Grades 9-12, and Imagine Cup keeps a category for students.

item.title: EP.008 · SAFE TO LEARN.
item.description: Safe to learn: US districts can add Microsoft's AI privacy standard, Study and Learn's locked mode is coming, and campus IT has time zones and fixes to check.

item.title: EP.007 · SHOW YOUR WORK.
item.description: The week's best for education: Elevate Showcase schools show their work, Edge PDF tools are on the way, and school IT gets new controls.

item.title: EP.006 · PLAN AHEAD.
item.description: The week's best for education: multi-week unit plans in Teach, previews to line up, and a January deadline for school IT.
